explain: Checks, from this node, that your sites and services answer. After two failed checks in a row a site is called down and you are told; you are told again when it is back.
name: Name
warn: The check starts from this node and can reach whatever it reaches. Only the status and the response time are kept.
history: Latest checks, newest on the right
checkNowTip: Checks right now instead of waiting for the next round
confirmDelete: Delete the check {{name}} and its history?
